items.text: Adam Levitan: Less than 24 hours from lock; very important player-specific discussions happening in ETR company Slack today (projections context, clearances, role notes).
items.why: Internal Slack on Jeanty clearance ADP boost, Bowers OUT adjustments, GL/role notes, Kamara/Etienne, docks for others.
items.implication: Last-minute projection shifts favoring cleared players and beneficiaries; listen to ETR content.
items.opportunity: Jeanty volume up; reverse any stale Bowers beneficiaries.

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers listed QUESTIONABLE (knee/ACL return); team elevated Braxton Berrios and signed Dalen Cambre. Full practices but final decision pending.
items.why: ACL recovery; full practices but self/coach caution on readiness; elevations as contingency.
items.implication: If limited/out, major target vacuum; if active, possible snap/route restriction.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries Malachi Fields/Wan'Dale/others; Isaiah Likely TE upside if Nabers limited (Berry note).

items.text: Patriots officially placed WR A.J. Brown on injured reserve (high-ankle sprain); expected multi-week absence.
items.why: High-ankle sprain; Schefter confirmation of IR placement and DT signing.
items.implication: Removes WR1 for NE; opens targets for other receivers and may impact Drake Maye.
items.opportunity: Target share boost for remaining NE WRs; waiver/handcuff implications limited short-term.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers ruled OUT for Week 1 after meniscus trim procedure; expected to miss 1-2 games. Confirmed across reports and ETR injury framework.
items.why: Meniscus trim surgery Tuesday; official designation and Schefter/Rapoport sourcing.
items.implication: Removes elite TE1; forces Raiders to other pass-catchers and elevates RB volume.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Michael Mayer and WR corps; more carries for Jeanty in MIA matchup.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty officially off injury report and good to go vs Dolphins after full practices; cleared ankle sprain.
items.why: Full participant all week; Schefter and team reports confirm no designation.
items.implication: High-end RB2/RB1 upside as focal point with Bowers out; workload may still be managed early.
items.opportunity: Primary carries and receiving work vs MIA; handcuff/backup uncertainty limited.

items.text: Falcons QB Cooper Rush will start vs Steelers despite Saturday back spasms; replacing injured Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix (both OUT).
items.why: Team confirmation he will start; Tua oblique and Penix knee OUT per reports.
items.implication: Lower-upside QB play; impacts ATL pass-catchers Drake London/Bijan usage potentially more run-heavy.
items.opportunity: Monitor for any late scratch; beneficiaries limited if Rush limited mobility.

items.text: Cowboys placed RB Malik Davis on IR (hip) and signed Israel Abanikanda from practice squad.
items.why: Hip injury in Friday practice; immediate IR and roster move.
items.implication: Removes DAL RB depth; elevates Javonte Williams and Abanikanda roles.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for Javonte Williams; Abanikanda as handcuff/beneficiary.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara QUESTIONABLE (knee/MCL); full Friday practice but designation remains. Etienne poised for bulk work if limited/out.
items.why: MCL sprain recovery; ETR/Thorman and CBS list Q with full practice.
items.implication: If out/limited, Etienne dominates NO backfield in up-tempo DET matchup.
items.opportunity: Etienne RB2/flex spike; Kendre Miller/others secondary. Pace up for NO@DET.

items.text: ETR/Thorman Snaps & Pace: NO@DET up in pace (fast environment); MIA@LV slow slog. Updated for Tua/Bowers news. GB@MIN also pace-up potential with Jacobs situation.
items.why: Neutral pace/POE data and game-script projections from Thorman; post-Bowers/Tua adjustments.
items.implication: Higher volume ceiling for DET/NO skill players; suppress LV/MIA totals somewhat.
items.opportunity: Gibbs full-snap potential; Etienne/Jeanty carry volume in respective scripts.

items.text: ETR/Thorman notes Josh Jacobs on Commissioner's Exempt List impacting GB pace (more pass, less time-suck); FantasyPros lists Jacobs among MIN-game inactives context. Monitor for official.
items.why: Commissioner's Exempt and early inactive listings.
items.implication: GB pace-up and condensed WR rotation; backup RB opportunity.
items.opportunity: Increased GB pass volume; Marshawn Lloyd or others for carries.

items.text: Matthew Berry contrarian: CMC is a BUY LOW despite preseason usage concerns and Kaelon Black looking good. Attributes to banged-up preseason, long flight, weird game; not worried.
items.why: Context of preseason limitations and travel; historical resilience.
items.implication: Start with confidence; ignore early narrative panic.
items.opportunity: Full role expected; Black as pure handcuff only.
items.conflict: Some market fretting over usage/Black looks.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love QUESTIONABLE/game-time (high ankle); limited practices. ETR/waiver notes flag Tyler Allgeier as primary beneficiary.
items.why: High ankle sprain from preseason; limited week, GTD designation.
items.implication: If out, Allgeier lead back; if active, possible limited snaps.
items.opportunity: Allgeier snaps/carries spike; monitor for ARI backfield clarity.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze QUESTIONABLE (calf); limited all week, plans to play per player but monitor inactives. ETR flagged as key watch.
items.why: Calf injury; limited practices, player optimistic, coach skeptical earlier.
items.implication: If inactive, target bump for DJ Moore/Luther Burden/others in CHI offense.
items.opportunity: Route/target share for remaining Bears WRs; have backup plan.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Isaiah Likely ranks 4th in TE fantasy PPG per target last 3 years; 8/9 games with 6+ targets = 12.5+ PPR. Nabers won't be 100%; Giants WR2 is Fields/Mooney. Gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Efficiency data + Nabers uncertainty creating TE opportunity in BAL.
items.implication: Strong TE streamer/flex if Nabers limited or out.
items.opportunity: Target spike potential with Nabers not full go.

items.text: Berry keeping it open on Chuba Hubbard as viable flex this week (The Chubbler); not full lock but playable.
items.why: Viable flex in current role; Brooks cleared but Hubbard 100% after full practices.
items.implication: Flex consideration over pure bench; monitor Brooks split.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share in CAR backfield vs CHI.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Saquon Barkley averages 136.5 rush yards and 6.0 YPC with 21+ PPR in 4 games vs WAS (incl playoffs); front seven still projects below average. Strong LOVE spot.
items.why: Historical dominance vs WAS + defensive projection.
items.implication: Elite RB1 start; bounce-back narrative supported by matchup data.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Chris Olave averaged 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% of games with Tyler Shough last year. Lions safeties on IR; high O/U game. Shough streamer available widely.
items.why: Prior chemistry + matchup (IR safeties) + game environment.
items.implication: Olave WR2/flex boost; Shough QB stream.
items.opportunity: High target volume in up-tempo NO@DET.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Parker Washington averaged 24% target share on 70%+ routes last year; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share. Browns Ward primarily on Brian Thomas Jr. Strong spot.
items.why: Route/target efficiency + favorable CB matchup shadow on BTJ.
